guard: A capability refusal settles the entry `refused` and holds the run uncatchably, and a later activation re-performs the step live: recorded as `failed`, or replayed instead of re-performed, or catchable, the run is broken forever instead of waiting.

mutations.name: a refusal rides the ordinary failure path and settles the entry failed
mutations.replace: // mutant: a refusal is an ordinary handler failure
mutations.expectRed: the refusal halts the run uncatchably, past try and finally alike
mutations.completionMarker: ok a workflow's catch does not swallow its host's stop
mutations.cell: the refusal halts the run uncatchably, past try and finally alike
mutations.note: Under the mutant the refusal settles `failed` as an EffectError, so the run rejects with the effect failure rather than RunHeld and the heal cell downstream replays the failure forever; the first cell of the section is the one that names the contract.

mutations.name: a refused entry is replayed instead of re-performed
mutations.replace: // mutant: refused falls through to replay
mutations.expectRed: with the spawn settled ok over the refusal, and the finalizer's notify recorded
mutations.completionMarker: ok the same journal on a capable host performs the step live and completes
mutations.cell: with the spawn settled ok over the refusal, and the finalizer's notify recorded
mutations.note: With the verdict arm gone a refused entry falls through to `replay`: the heal run completes anyway (its program never dereferences the replayed handle), so the discriminating fact is durable, not observable in the outcome — the spawn entry is still `refused`, and only the settled-ok cell can see that. The heal cell printing green under this mutant is what makes it the marker.

mutations.name: the hold is catchable, so a finalizer runs after it
mutations.expectRed: and the finalizer performed nothing: no notify was recorded
mutations.completionMarker: ok the refusal halts the run uncatchably, past try and finally alike
mutations.cell: and the finalizer performed nothing: no notify was recorded
mutations.note: With RunHeld out of the walker's uncatchable set the finalizer runs on the way out and records a notify, which is one more effect by a run that was told to stop. The halt cell itself stays green (the class still propagates), so only the finalizer cell can see this.
